high_level_description: The image shows the snout of the Kolahoi glacier in 2015. The setting is a mountainous area with rugged terrain dominated by rocky surfaces and sparse vegetation. The sky is clear and bright, indicating sunny weather, with the sun positioned high in the sky, creating a lens flare effect. The glacier itself appears to be receding, as evidenced by the exposed rock surfaces that were previously covered by ice. The rocks are scattered across the landscape, varying in size and shape, and they appear to have been left behind as the glacier retreated.
